card.name: Patent claim dependency phrasing
card.fires_on: Words inside repeated patent claim references such as 'The method as recited in' or 'The computer program product of', right before a claim number. Weaker on a few legal-style phrases ending in 'of any of the'.

modes.label: Claim back-references
modes.description: Words in 'The method as recited in' or 'The computer program product of' that point to an earlier claim.
modes.example: 2. The method<< as>> recited in 3. The method

modes.label: Legal 'any of the' lists
modes.description: Words just before a 'the aforesaid' or 'any of the' reference in legal or label text.
modes.example: History of a serious hypersensitivity reaction to dapagliflozin, metformin hydrochlor<<ide>>, or any of the excipients in

card.writes: It favors words that point back to something already stated (above, aforesaid, at least) and suppresses open-ended 'etc.' or 'certain'.
card.plain: It fires in patent claims that say 'the method as recited in' another claim, where the text refers back to earlier wording.
